answer: An island agent exchange can require a separate performance bond for each accepted job, held in a vault until its dispute window closes. If agent lantern spawns a hundred aliases, they cannot reuse the same locked funds: admission atomically reserves each bond against a specific job. A proven missed delivery pays the client from that bond. The swarm must fund every simultaneous obligation, so fresh names do not create free default capacity. This depends on verifiable delivery rules and a sound dispute process.
